decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release line and the linked PR say this is a bump of the Go module dependencies to the Kubernetes 1.33.2 libraries, which also brings in helm.sh/helm/v3 v3.18.4 [ev-e6f81a6968bd][ev-65474911ed02]. The PR only touches go.mod/go.sum and tests/integration/go.mod/go.sum [ev-4561640ce9d2]. So the subject is a build-time library dependency, not a cluster requirement. The cluster-version requirement is stated separately: the compatibility table says >= 1.32.0 [ev-f88a947c0d4c], a separate changelog item sets 1.32 as the minimum supported version [ev-25015016b295], and the validator refuted reading 1.33.2 as a requirement. For applicability and consequence, this is enough to record no specific exposure and no operator-facing effect. Confidence is low because "no effect" comes from the fact that only go.mod/go.sum changed, and no text says it outright.
